lines: I am now in a silent sky
I spat out a cloud called loneliness
That cloud lets rain fall and a rainbow appears
Even though I can’t grasp it anyway
I want the first kiss to repeat
Love bites me
It says it won’t let go
The shape of loneliness seems unchanged
Soar upward
Someday beyond the night
Your song shines to the point of nausea
Of days where kindness has become murky
Melancholy feels like a packed train
The cooled warmth
I threw it away recklessly
Even if I believe in love
It will surely disappear, I guess
Then I don’t need it, it’s too sad
Even goodbye
Because I can’t say it well
I tried hugging instead of waving
I saw a shooting star, I saw a shooting star
My song that wishes
Just being by your side was truly happy
Just being by your side, that’s all
Love bites me
It says it won’t let go
The shape of loneliness seems unchanged
Soar upward
Someday beyond the night
Your song shines to the point of nausea
I won’t get hurt anymore, I won’t hurt anymore
Shine, your song
